title: Analytics Engineer
description: Bridge data engineering and business intelligence by modeling clean, tested, documented, and production-ready data marts using dbt, SQL, and Git.

goal.objective: Transform raw data lakehouse tables into clean, tested, and reliable business-ready data models that power company-wide decision making.
career_pillars: Data Quality Testing & CI/CD for Data

learn.summary: Master advanced analytical SQL (Window functions, CTEs), dbt Core/Cloud modeling, version-controlled data pipelines, semantic layers, and automated schema testing.
key_competencies: dbt (Data Build Tool) Modeling, Macros & Packages

capstone_projects.title: Production dbt Analytics Warehouse with Snowflake & CI/CD
capstone_projects.description: Architect a modular analytics data warehouse utilizing dbt Core, automated CI testing with Slim CI, semantic layer definitions, and Elementary anomaly alerting.

capstone_projects.title: Real-Time Streaming Analytics & Semantic Layer Platform
capstone_projects.description: Construct a high-throughput real-time analytical pipeline feeding a Cube.js semantic layer with sub-second query latency and role-based data access.

interview_focus: dbt Incremental Models (Merge vs Append Strategies & Unique Keys)
Data Modeling (Kimball Dimensional Modeling vs One Big Table / OBT)
Snowflake Clustering Keys, Micro-Partitions & Warehouse Sizing
Data Quality Frameworks (dbt tests, Elementary anomaly monitoring, Great Expectations)
Semantic Layer Architecture (Metrics definitions & BI caching layers)

tree.name: Introduction to Analytics Engineering & Data Fundamentals
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable analytics engineering foundation: master the Modern Data Stack (MDS), advanced analytical SQL, cloud data warehouse mechanics, and disciplined version control.

resources.title: What is Analytics Engineering? - A Beginner's Guide
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Understanding the Analytics Engineer Role
children.description: Understand the Analytics Engineer role in modern data organizations: bridging the gap between Data Engineers (infrastructure and ingestion) and Data Analysts/Business Stakeholders (insights and reporting); applying software engineering best practices to data transformation.

resources.title: What is an analytics engineer? What do they do? | The Data Pinch Ep.29

children.name: Advanced SQL Proficiency
children.description: Master advanced analytical SQL: complex multi-stage CTE architectures, analytical window functions (`DENSE_RANK`, `PERCENT_RANK`, `LEAD`, `LAG`), conditional aggregations (`CASE WHEN`), pivoting, array manipulation (`UNNEST`/`FLATTEN`), and query plan cost optimization.

resources.title: Advanced SQL Tutorial | Learn Advanced SQL Concepts in this Full Course

children.name: Data Warehousing & Lakehouse Concepts
children.description: Master modern cloud analytical warehouses: Snowflake, Google BigQuery, and Databricks SQL; understanding micro-partitioning, partition pruning, clustering keys, columnar execution engines, and compute warehouse sizing.

resources.title: Build Data Lakes and Data Warehouses on Google Cloud
Data Warehouse Tutorial For Beginners | Data Warehouse Concepts
Data Lake vs Data Warehouse vs Data Lakehouse Explained

children.name: Data Ingestion & ELT Concepts
children.description: Understand modern ELT ingestion architectures: extracting and loading raw data with Fivetran, Airbyte, or custom connectors; raw schema staging; handling semi-structured JSON payloads; and maintaining ingestion idempotency.

resources.title: Data Warehouse vs Data Lake vs Data Lakehouse | ETL, OLAP vs OLTP
What is a Data Pipeline? ETL Explained & Data Pipeline Use Cases

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Implement disciplined Git workflows for analytics code: trunk-based development, branch naming conventions, atomic commits, pull request reviews with automated CI testing, and semantic tagging.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

tree.name: Data Modeling and Transformation with dbt
tree.description: Master analytics engineering with dbt (data build tool): dimensional modeling, incremental materializations, data testing frameworks, semantic layers, and automated CI/CD.

resources.title: Analytics Engineering with dbt Workshop - Juan Manuel Perafan (DataTalksClub)

children.name: Introduction to dbt
children.description: Master dbt Core and dbt Cloud fundamentals: project structure (`dbt_project.yml`, `profiles.yml`), model creation, dependency graphs using the `ref()` function, source definitions using `source()`, and running models with `dbt run`.

resources.title: dbt Tutorial for Beginners - Learn Data Transformation with dbt

children.name: Dimensional Modeling in dbt
children.description: Implement Ralph Kimball dimensional modeling in dbt: architecting clean multi-layer transformation pipelines (Staging `stg_`, Intermediate `int_`, and Marts `fct_` and `dim_`), surrogate key generation with `dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key`, and managing Slowly Changing Dimensions with `dbt snapshot` (SCD Type 2 timestamp and check strategies).

resources.title: Structure and Model a dbt Project
dbt Snapshots: Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 2)

children.name: Complex SQL Patterns for dbt Transformations
children.description: Author clean, modular dbt transformations: writing reusable Jinja macros, looping over columns with Jinja control structures, custom schema naming macros, and integrating community packages via `packages.yml` (`dbt-utils`, `dbt-expectations`).

resources.title: SQL Window Function | How to write SQL Query using RANK, DENSE RANK, LEAD/LAG

children.name: Building Advanced dbt Models & Materializations
children.description: Master dbt materialization strategies: views for lightweight abstractions, tables for performant querying, ephemeral models for inline CTEs, and high-efficiency incremental models (`materialized='incremental'`) configured with `unique_key` and optimal merge strategies.

resources.title: dbt Materializations - Views, Tables, Incremental, Ephemeral
dbt Jinja & Macros Tutorial: Go Beyond Basic SQL

children.name: Data Quality, Testing, and Validation
children.description: Enforce rigorous automated data quality: built-in generic tests (`unique`, `not_null`, `relationships`, `accepted_values`), custom singular SQL tests, advanced statistical assertions with `dbt-expectations`, and configuring test severity thresholds (warn vs error).

resources.title: Write Custom Generic Data Tests in dbt
dbt Tests Explained: Unique, Not Null, Accepted Values, Relationships
How to Data Test like a Pro with dbt & Python | dbt Tutorial | Data with Danny

children.name: Documentation, Lineage, and Discovery
children.description: Build automated enterprise data catalogs: documenting models and columns in YAML manifests, generating and serving interactive dbt documentation (`dbt docs generate`), visualizing end-to-end Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) data lineage, and tracking column-level dependencies.

resources.title: dbt Data Documentation: What It Is, Why You Need It, & How To Use It
Data Lineage - How it works & why you need it

tree.name: Advanced dbt, Performance & Operations
tree.description: Master advanced dbt operations: implementing the dbt Semantic Layer (MetricFlow) for defining centralized, reusable business metrics, dbt hooks (pre-hook, post-hook for granting permissions), custom materializations, and exposure definitions.

resources.title: Deploying dbt to Production | dbt Learn

children.name: dbt & Data Warehouse Performance Tuning
children.description: Profile and optimize warehouse query costs: analyzing compilation times, tuning incremental model filter conditions, optimizing clustering keys in Snowflake/BigQuery, and eliminating redundant intermediate joins.

resources.title: Choose dbt Materializations for Model Performance
Deep Dive into dbt Materializations - Incremental Models (dbt Learn)
Cost Optimize your dbt models in Snowflake

children.name: Data Orchestration & Scheduling
children.description: Orchestrate dbt pipelines in production: integrating dbt with modern orchestrators (Astronomer Cosmos for Airflow, Dagster Software-Defined Assets, or dbt Cloud Jobs), scheduling hourly/daily runs, and managing execution dependencies.

resources.title: Run dbt Workflows with Apache Airflow
Create and Schedule dbt Deployment Jobs
Orchestrate dbt Projects with Airflow: A Step-by-Step Guide

children.name: CI/CD for dbt Projects
children.description: Implement cost-efficient CI/CD with Slim CI: automated GitHub Actions pipelines running dbt Slim CI (`dbt build --select state:modified+`) comparing against production artifacts to run and test only changed models, reducing CI warehouse spend by over 80%.

resources.title: Building CI/CD for dbt with GitHub Actions
Building a dbt CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
Data Engineering CICD pipeline with DBT on Github Actions

children.name: Monitoring, Alerting, and Observability
children.description: Monitor data freshness and pipeline health: configuring source freshness tests (`dbt source freshness`), setting up Slack / PagerDuty alerts on test failures, and tracking pipeline execution duration metrics.

resources.title: What is Data Observability? | A Quick Intro
Monitoring Data Pipelines: The 4 Key Metrics

children.name: Data Governance & Security Best Practices
children.description: Implement enterprise data governance: data classification tagging, column-level masking policies (hashing PII emails/names), row-level security policies, and managing role-based access control (RBAC) grants in dbt.

resources.title: What is Data Governance? Explained for Beginners

tree.name: Stakeholder Collaboration & Career Readiness
tree.description: Bridge technical data models with business stakeholders: requirements gathering, semantic layer integration, and technical interview preparation.

resources.title: Slide Presentations — MIT EECS Communication Lab
Data Storytelling Tutorial - The Easiest Way to Present Data
Build a Data Science Portfolio with Python

children.name: Requirements Gathering & Stakeholder Communication
children.description: Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous data schemas: conducting stakeholder discovery interviews, defining single sources of truth, documenting data contracts, and mapping entity relationship diagrams.

resources.title: Frame Data Problems and Define Success Metrics (Google)
Requirements Gathering Process (How to Gather Requirements)
Effective Communication Skills For Data Analysts

children.name: BI Tool Integration & Semantic Layer
children.description: Connect modeled data marts to modern Business Intelligence platforms: Looker (LookML modeling), Tableau, Power BI, or Lightdash; optimizing BI query performance, and eliminating disparate definitions of core KPIs.

resources.title: dbt Exposures: Document Downstream BI Dependencies
What is a Semantic Layer? The Basics of Metric Consistency
Build a Semantic Layer with dbt MetricFlow

children.name: Data Storytelling & Visualization Principles
children.description: Communicate insights effectively: building executive dashboards, choosing appropriate visual encodings, and presenting data model changes alongside quantified business impact.

resources.title: Fundamentals of Data Visualization (Claus O. Wilke)
Data Visualization Caveats — From Data to Viz
Data Storytelling Course - Learn to Tell Your Data Story

children.name: Analytics Engineering Capstone Project
children.description: Portfolio Project: Build an End-to-End Enterprise Analytics Platform: raw ingestion with Airbyte/Fivetran, full dimensional model in dbt (staging, intermediate, dimension and fact marts), automated Slim CI on GitHub Actions, dbt-expectations tests, and an interactive BI dashboard.

resources.title: How to Build a Data Analytics Portfolio
Build a Data Engineering Project From Scratch - Full Course

children.name: Interview Preparation & Industry Trends
children.description: Excel in Analytics Engineering technical interviews: live SQL data transformation challenges (window functions, deduplication), dimensional modeling case studies (designing an e-commerce or subscription SaaS data mart), and deep dbt architecture questions.

resources.title: Analytics Engineer Interview Questions - What to expect!

children.name: Case Study & Project Documentation
children.description: Author a Technical Case Study: document a transformation initiative where messy, un-modeled spaghetti SQL queries were refactored into a modular, tested, and documented dbt repository, detailing warehouse cost savings, improved data freshness, and stakeholder trust.

Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
How to Write a Data Science Case Study - Building a Portfolio
